title: Doesn't seem to work in my room as expected
text: Doesn't seem to work in my room as expected. I think due to the size of my room I don't really notice a difference. It's a neat night light though. Pretty quite. The one thing I don't like is that the top doesn't screw on it just sets in which has caused quite a few spills so far unfortunately which ruined some stuff. Otherwise okay for a small humidifier as long as it's a small space.
